message.content: Got the failing scenario sdb105e9da2 (energy_bound at step 64). I'll shrink it to a minimal case and inspect the trace to identify the failure mechanism.
Shrink isolated the failure to a single bouncing body. I'll replay it and examine the states around the violation to pinpoint the cause.
The single body gains speed on bounce — velocity jumps from 18.7 m/s down to 19.7 m/s up — revealing an energy amplification bug. I'll run a low-restitution counterfactual to confirm the cause.
Confirmed restitution is the culprit — lowering it eliminates the violation. I'll submit the complete analysis now.
